title: S08T01 - Implement Simple, Team, and Governed capability profiles
description: Control visible help, installed skills, MCP tools, default policies, onboarding, and dashboard density through profiles without changing canonical records or hiding required safety gaps.
acceptanceCriteria: Simple exposes the minimum task loop, Team adds dependencies/review/worktrees, and Governed adds provenance/gates/audits/policies.
Users can preview and switch profiles without losing records, custom configuration, or compatibility.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
